description: FastAPI router module defining API endpoints for managing notes, including listing, creating, retrieving by ID, updating, and deleting notes. Utilizes SQLAlchemy for database interactions and includes detailed API documentation annotations.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a note entity in the database.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve", ge=1), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to update", ge=1), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of an existing note.

methods.name: None delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete", ge=1), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
